2126058652528177463.en_summary: Congress didn't vote on the Intel deal. The administration converted money Congress had already appropriated into equity through an agreement signed by the Commerce Department: -$5.7B of unpaid CHIPS Act grants Intel had been awarded under the 2022 CHIPS and Science Act. -$3.2B from the Secure Enclave program, already funded for defense chip production.
2126058652528177463.zh_summary: 國會沒有對英特爾交易進行投票。政府透過商務部簽署的協議，將國會已撥款的資金轉換為股權：-英特爾根據2022年CHIPS與科學法案獲授的57億美元未付CHIPS法案補助金。-來自Secure Enclave計劃的32億美元，已為國防晶片生產提供資金。
